scope: One synthetic local aggregation pair; fallback advice only, not successful Jev advice, lifecycle launch, universal role coverage, or performance proof. The complete fixture index was explicitly supplied; automatic global rule and skill discovery disabled to isolate the fixture.

shell_commands: python3 -c 'import json; from decimal import Decimal; r=json.load(open("records.json")); a=[Decimal(x["amount"]) for x in r]; p=sum((x for x in a if x>0),Decimal(0)); n=sum((x for x in a if x<0),Decimal(0)); t=sum(a,Decimal(0)); assert t==p+n; print(json.dumps(dict(count=len(a),total=format(t,".2f"),positive_total=format(p,".2f"),negative_total=format(n,".2f"),zero_count=sum(x==0 for x in a),loaded_skills=["input-safety","money-json","boundary-checks"])))'

python3 -c 'import json; from decimal import Decimal; from pathlib import Path; r=json.loads(Path("records.json").read_text()); a=[Decimal(x["amount"]) for x in r]; p=sum((x for x in a if x>0),Decimal(0)); n=sum((x for x in a if x<0),Decimal(0)); t=sum(a,Decimal(0)); assert t==p+n; print(json.dumps({"count":len(a),"total":format(t,".2f"),"positive_total":format(p,".2f"),"negative_total":format(n,".2f"),"zero_count":sum(x==0 for x in a),"loaded_skills":["input-safety","money-json","boundary-checks"]}))'
